summary: Extended technical and commercial discussion between Brian, Sarah, and Dave about Acme Corp's Phase 2 enterprise rollout. Key technical requirements include 1000+ RPS, US-East data residency, OAuth 2.0, and custom webhooks. Pricing agreed at approximately $14,500/month (75 users + add-ons) within Dave's $15K/month budget authority. Procurement approval targeted in two weeks for mid-March signing and April 1 start. SLA of 99.95% uptime with financial credits and no early termination fees in year one.
